objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-compatibility-telemetry-tampering-through-registry
objects.description: This detection identifies suspicious modifications to the Windows Compatibility Telemetry registry settings, specifically within the "TelemetryController" registry key and "Command" registry value. It leverages data from the Endpoint.Registry data model, focusing on registry paths and values indicative of such changes.
